skill.runner.camouflage.desc: §lHiding§r lingers for up to 10 seconds after you stop crouching. Furthermore, you're more nimble in that state.
skill.runner.brawler.desc:
Punch killers to stun them. Each hit comes with great knockback, and adds 1.5s to their stun duration. Attacking 3 consecutive times triggers a cooldown.

Cooldown: §l15s

§cNote: Runners cannot attack while §lHiding§r§c.
skill.runner.jumper.desc:
While §lHiding§r, crouch in place to charge a jump boost. The longer you charge, the higher you'll jump, and the louder you'll be.

If you stop §lHiding§r, the boost will end.

Max Charges: §l7
skill.runner.medic.desc:
Dance at recent runner corpses to revive them. This alerts the killer, grants you points depending on band progression, and even more if they make it to the end.
- Revived teammates have no skills, and gain half points.

Limit: §l2§r
Revive Time: §l10s
skill.runner.medic.revive: %s has been revived! They are now §csoul-bound§r to %s.
skill.runner.undying.desc:
After dying once, you begin to revive yourself. This takes 20 seconds, and upon resurrection:
- You're healed by 50%.
- Your skills are disabled.
- Your point gain is halved.
- Everyone is alerted.
skill.runner.puppeteer.desc:
Throw puppets that resemble yourself. If a killer attacks your puppet, they get stunned and award you points.

You have two types of puppets; the mananequin looks like you, and the fake mouse looks like a runner who's §lHiding§r.

Cooldown (Large Puppet): §l45s§r
Cooldown (Small Puppet): §l15s
skill.runner.puppeteer.small_puppet.anno: %s attacked a fake mouse and been stunned!
skill.runner.puppeteer.large_puppet.anno: %s attacked a mannequin and been severely stunned!
skill.runner.warper.desc:
Cross bands to gain §lTime§r §lWarps§r; upon use, your position warps 5 seconds back in time.

Cooldown: §l30s§r
Limit: §l2
skill.runner.alchemist.desc:
You start with two sets of 3 §lFlasks§r. Using one §lFlask§r depletes both sets.
- §lBlinding§r §lFlasks§r: when thrown, they blind any killers they hit, awarding you points upon band completion.
- §lStunning§r §lFlasks§r: Instead of blinding the killer, the killer gets stunned for half the time.

Cooldown: §l30s§r
Limit: §l1
skill.runner.random.desc: Your runner skills will be randomly selected.
skill.killer.athlete.desc:
Activate a dash to gain a huge boost to your speed and movement for several seconds.

Duration: §l3.5s§r
Cooldown: §l15s
skill.killer.locator.desc:
Gain a compass that tracks the farthest runners within a 32m radius. This compass can be used to "lock-on" to the current target temporarily, before going on cooldown.

Cooldown: §l20s
skill.killer.locator.notification: Somebody has locked onto your position.
skill.killer.specter.desc:
Activate a cloak to gain invisibility for several seconds.

Duration: §l6s§r
Cooldown: §l30s§r

§cNote: Killers lose invisibility after attacking.
skill.killer.gemini.desc: Spawn with two bodies, being able to freely swap between them. Your inactive body is quite vulnerable, and may be permanently killed by the runners after 10 hits.
skill.killer.random.desc: Your killer skills will be randomly selected.
skill.weapon.dagger.desc: Melee-only weapon that increases your movement speed slightly and decreases the successful hit cooldown.
skill.weapon.trident.desc: Does +5 more damage, and can be thrown endlessly.
skill.weapon.foreseer.desc:
Fires spectral arrows that, upon hitting a block, reveal all nearby runners. While on cooldown, it only fires normal arrows.

Cooldown: §l20s
skill.weapon.random.desc: Your weapon will be randomly selected.
